## Vitest Configuration Review

### Config files found

| # | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `vitest.config.ts` | Main test runner config |
| 2 | `vitest.benchmark.config.mts` | Benchmark test runner config |

The repo pins `"vitest": "^2.1.4"` (installed: `2.1.9`). All upstream references below are from **vitest v5.0.0** (current stable at `vitest.dev`).

---

### Finding: `test.server.deps.external` — deprecated as of Vitest 4

Both files set:

```ts
// vitest.config.ts:46-49, vitest.benchmark.config.mts:35
server: {
  deps: {
    external: ["node:sqlite"],
  },
},
```

The upstream doc at [vitest.dev/config/server](https://vitest.dev/config/server) is titled **"server deprecated"** and states:

> "Before Vitest 4, this option was used to define the configuration for the `vite-node` server."
> "WARNING: These options should be used only as the last resort to improve performance by externalizing auto-inlined dependencies or to fix issues by inlining invalid external dependencies. **Normally, Vitest should do this automatically.**"

The option still *works* in v5 (it hasn't been removed), but it is officially deprecated. There is **no direct successor** — the standalone `deps` page ([vitest.dev/config/deps](https://vitest.dev/config/deps)) has no `external` field; it only covers `optimizer`, `client`, `interopDefault`, and `moduleDirectories`. The intent is that Vitest now handles externalization automatically.

| Repo file | Upstream doc |
|---|---|
| `vitest.config.ts:46–49` | [vitest.dev/config/server](https://vitest.dev/config/server) |
| `vitest.benchmark.config.mts:35` | [vitest.dev/config/server](https://vitest.dev/config/server) |

### All other options — current, no issues

| Option | Repo location | Status | Upstream doc checked |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resolve.alias` | Both files (top-level Vite option) | **Current** | [vite.dev/config/shared-options](https://vite.dev/config/shared-options) |
| `ssr.external` | Both files (top-level Vite option) | **Current** | [vite.dev/config/ssr-options](https://vite.dev/config/ssr-options) |
| `test.environment` | Both files | **Current** (default is `'node'`) | [vitest.dev/config/environment](https://vitest.dev/config/environment) |
| `test.include` | Both files | **Current** (type `string[]`, glob patterns) | [vitest.dev/config/include](https://vitest.dev/config/include) |
| `test.testTimeout` | `vitest.config.ts:45`, `vitest.benchmark.config.mts:33` | **Current** (type `number`, default 5000) | [vitest.dev/config/testtimeout](https://vitest.dev/config/testtimeout) |
| `test.hookTimeout` | `vitest.benchmark.config.mts:34` | **Current** (type `number`, default 10000) | [vitest.dev/config/hooktimeout](https://vitest.dev/config/hooktimeout) |
| `defineConfig` from `"vitest/config"` | Both files | **Current** (still the recommended import path) | [vitest.dev/config](https://vitest.dev/config/) |

---

### Summary

One finding: **`server.deps.external`** (used in both config files to externalize `node:sqlite`) is deprecated as of Vitest 4. It still functions but the docs advise it should be a last resort, as Vitest now externalizes dependencies automatically. If/when you upgrade past v2.x, this will emit deprecation warnings. No replacement option exists — the expectation is that automatic behavior suffices. Everything else in both configs is current per the v5.0.0 docs.
